title: The Carpool Excuse That Lasted 9 Weeks

beats.theme: the car that is always 'in service' so its owner never takes his driving turn

lines.text: If your friend's car is always in service, I'm that car.
Rohan's hatchback. Haven't moved in nine weeks.
Four neighbours, one carpool. Arjun tapes a driving roster to the lift door.
Monday, Arjun. Tuesday, Priya. Wednesday, Rohan.
Week one, a sticky note. Car in service.
Week three. In service. Clutch.
Week six. In service. AC emotionally unwell.
My AC is fine. I'm a car. I don't have feelings.
So every Wednesday, Arjun drives him instead.
Then the lift opens, and the roster rips right through Wednesday.
That night, Priya walks past me. Spotless. Full tyres.
And Rohan finally cracks.
He can't drive. Never learned. He bought me for the photos.
Lesson: skipping your turn is fine. Faking a clutch isn't.
So the pool ditched the lift door for an app.
Rohan rides, and pays his share through settle costs.
The other three take turns behind the wheel.
He confessed in the pool's group chat.
Sharma ji replied: driving lessons, Sunday, my car.
Me? Still parked. Every evening, Rohan sits in me, making steering noises.
Calls it practice.
If your carpool runs on excuses, try Sahyatri.
